title: AQ CapabilityLease (Foundation C0 — report-only inert primitive)
description: Validates a signed CapabilityLease document. NOTE on signing: the `signature` field is EXCLUDED from the signable digest — canonical_payload() in scripts/ai/lib/capability_lease.py serializes every other field (deterministic JSON, sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8) and HMAC-SHA256's that payload. `signature` itself is never part of what it signs. This slice is report-only: no evaluator/executor consumes this schema yet (C1+).

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: The attested identity a lease is issued to. Derived/verified at the trust boundary — never taken from the caller's own claim.

principal_id.description: Stable identifier for the principal (agent/service/human/remote-lane instance).

attestation.description: How the principal was proven: OAuth-session-ref | systemd-unit-cred | signed-a2a-envelope (free-text reference, not the credential itself).

constraints.description: Free-form tightening constraints (e.g. rate/ttl/path scoping). Attenuation (scripts/ai/lib/capability_lease.py attenuate()) may only add keys or narrow existing ones, never widen — narrowing is type-dependent: numeric values must not increase, list/tuple/set values must shrink to a subset, and any other value type (str/bool/dict/mismatched types) must match the parent exactly since no partial-order narrowing is defined for it.

issued_to.description: principal_id of the Principal (see #/$defs/principal) this lease was issued to.

input_schema.description: Arbitrary JSON Schema fragment constraining tool input.

output_schema.description: Arbitrary JSON Schema fragment constraining tool output.

parent_lease_id.description: lease_id of the parent this lease was attenuated from, or null for a top-level lease.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest over canonical_payload(lease) — i.e. over every OTHER field in this object. Excluded from its own signable payload.
